lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is irregular, with larger gaps in the midsection and closer grouping towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 3 and 4 from the anterior terminate in the mid-torso region; line 6 is comprised of three dashed vertical segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three high-contrast white spots are clustered on the lateral surface of the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The three spots on the posterior haunch are aligned in a horizontal linear orientation across the thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a posterior-lateral spiral at the base transitioning into an inward and upward terminal sweep.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.75 times the width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct white facial spots (one sub-orbital, one on the bridge of the nose); a white dorsal crest; and white leg markings with black banding above the carpal and tarsal joints.
